in_sanskrit.name: Poltu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Poltu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'padmini' meaning lotus, the name Poltu symbolizes purity, grace and beauty. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is considered a sacred flower as it grows in muddy waters but remains untouched by them. The lotus represents the divine potential in individuals to rise above their circumstances and achieve enlightenment.
